def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k == 0:
        return [0] * n

    vals = sorted(set(a))
    rank = {v: idx for idx, v in enumerate(vals, 1)}
    comp = [rank[v] for v in a]
    m = len(vals)

    tree = [0] * (m + 1)
    ans = [0] * n

    for i, r in enumerate(comp):
        if i > k:
            rem = comp[i - k - 1]
            while rem <= m:
                tree[rem] -= 1
                rem += rem & -rem

        le = 0
        q = r
        while q > 0:
            le += tree[q]
            q -= q & -q

        in_window = i if i < k else k
        ans[i] = in_window - le

        u = r
        while u <= m:
            tree[u] += 1
            u += u & -u

    return ans
